text:
acme_accounts: Hi, our invoice INV-2026-00421 is stuck as 'VAT charged' even though we requested reverse-charge. We uploaded acme_resale_declaration.pdf with VAT ID FR12345678901 but the portal shows VIES status 'inactive' and won't accept a second file. Month-end accounting is blocked. Can someone help?

sasha_support: Sorry about that — can you paste the exact VAT ID you used and the file name? I'll escalate to billing.

acme_accounts: VAT ID: FR12345678901; file: acme_resale_declaration.pdf. When I try to reupload I get: "Upload failed: 422 Unprocessable Entity". Also saw a 503 earlier from VIES. Link to support upload: https://redwood.example.com/support/uploads/abc123 (returns 422).

sasha_support: I repro'd the upload error in our QA account: multipart upload returns 422 when X-Client-Region header missing. Filing internal ticket for uploads service. For immediate unblock, can you confirm whether the seller is actually registered in BE or FR? The VAT format you gave looks French (SIREN-like).

acme_accounts: Sorry for the confusion — the seller is a Belgian marketplace merchant but the billing address we used is their French HQ. Marketplace shows BE VAT BE0123456789. We tried to attach both BE_VAT.pdf and marketplace_agreement.pdf but portal refused the second file.

sasha_support: @ivan_billing can you manually hold the invoice and check if we can apply reverse-charge once compliance verifies the BE VAT? Customer said marketplace flow should make it intra-Community (BE -> FR customer).

ivan_billing: I can manually apply an override but need Compliance approval to mark it reverse-charge. VIES lookup for BE0123456789 currently returns 'inactive' due to intermittent VIES outages. If compliance accepts the national registry PDF we can proceed.

jurgen_finance: Quick note: reverse-charge rules depend on seller vs buyer countries. If seller is BE and buyer FR (business-to-business) reverse charge applies. If both are FR, it does not. Given the registry ambiguity, request the official national VAT confirmation or an attestation from the marketplace operator.

acme_accounts: Uploaded BE_VAT.pdf to an S3 link and emailed invoices@redwood.com with subject 'INV-2026-00421 urgent'. S3: https://s3.eu-west-1.amazonaws.com/acme/proofs/BE_VAT.pdf — let me know if you can access. :pray:

sasha_support: I can't attach from S3 to billing UI, but will include the S3 link in ticket. Creating compliance escalation now.

compliance-bot: New escalation created: COMP-2026-1789. Owner: compliance_team. Required docs: validated BE VAT number, marketplace seller agreement, proof of B2B transaction. SLA: 72h (month-end priority).

ivan_billing: Once compliance confirms, I will: 1) set Invoice INV-2026-00421 to 'on hold', 2) apply manual tax override in billing_admin -> Invoices -> INV-2026-00421 -> Actions -> Apply Tax Override -> Reverse charge, 3) reissue corrected invoice to the customer. Please CC accounting@acme.com when done.

jurgen_finance: Internal repro steps for billing/compliance: 
1) Download attachments from ticket COMP-2026-1789. 
2) If VIES is unavailable, validate VAT via national registry (Belgium: https://economie.fgov.be). 
3) Verify marketplace contract shows seller ID BE0123456789 and that the buyer is a French VAT-registered business. 
4) Apply manual override in billing_admin and add audit note: 'Manual reverse-charge applied per COMP-2026-1789; docs attached.'

sasha_support: Temporary workaround for customer: if upload continues failing, paste a secure link or email invoices@redwood.com. We'll mark thread P1 and escalate.

acme_accounts: Email sent and link shared. Thanks — waiting for confirmation.

sasha_support: Thanks all, I'll update when compliance verifies.
